6 September 2026

The Townstons is live again. You can edit pages once more. Sign up, confirm your email, and jump in. We are actively writing new articles and improving the old ones. That means YOU too.

15 January 2009

In response to many requests, a new PvP Category has been added. We only have a few PvP articles and they have been collected into that category. Now, those of you who requested a PvP Category need to begin contributing your tips!!--Catwalksbyhimself 15:03, 16 January 2009 (CET)

8 January 2009

Build 155 is live (finally!) and the new Skills are awesome. Information is being gathered and some is posted but we need YOUR help in filling out the skills, and providing tactics for using them and new Builds incorporating them!--Catwalksbyhimself 07:51, 9 January 2009 (CET)

12 September 2008

Excitement! Stephen was on W1 this morning, and asked players opinions on going to Play Test with the new Chunk MINUS the posses. Seems they are giving the most trouble and the devs working on them were among the laid off. Player reaction was positive, and Stephen indicated a very good chance that the new chunk will be on the Play Test Server TOMORROW 9/12. Everyone is looking forward to it!

Much help will be needed updating the Wiki so we are looking for lots of player contributions!

--Catwalksbyhimself 20:35, 11 September 2008 (CEST)

*wakes up and crawls out of his hole* What.. where? Chunk 4? Ive had my winter sleep, waked up and still Chunk 4 aint on? Well, Im glad to hear this. Ill fire up my engines, and I expect my great contributors to do so too, as well as the random person (Yes You!) that reads this. All help is appriciated. Oeeee I cant wait until Chunk 4! --LegendRunner 21:38, 11 September 2008 (CEST)

It is on the PTS! And it is awesome. Great new dungeon L80-100, new mobs, and a new Boss, Manglefeet, who is a H*ll of a fight! New ranger weps including all sorts of cannons. Count of potions on the UI. The Wishing Well! The Cowboy is there (Amazon's boyfriend?) but no Posses yet. Some green armor that looks like a glowstick. Who knows what else?? We need LOTS of help in all the updating that will have to be done!--Catwalksbyhimself 06:03, 13 September 2008 (CEST)

Sept 26th THE CHUNK IS LIVE!

And it is awesome. Much help is needed to update the Wiki! That means YOU!! The skeleton for Mutant Mania is available. Please add your information as you explore its levels. The Manglefeet Boss Guide skeleton is up, and we need every tip YOU can give us! Quests need to be updated. Everytime you do a quest, please put it up! Tell us about the Wishing Well. Lots and lots of new Rainbow Items! So much to do. Every contribution is needed. --Catwalksbyhimself 13:21, 26 September 2008 (CEST)

Oct 27th PROGRESS, BUT HELP STILL NEEDED

The preliminary Manglefeet Boss Guide is begun but lots of YOUR experience still needs to be added. The levels of Mutant Mania are being explored and side dungeons and NPC's added. Contributions to fill it out are needed. The Mutant Mania Quests have a good start but are not complete. Lots of new Rainbow items still need to be added. PLEASE help out!--Catwalksbyhimself 16:07, 27 October 2008 (CET)

12 July 2008

Hey folks, first off, I will keep this message shorter then intended. I wrote for half an hour, and when I tried to submit it, I got an error and now I gotta type it all over again, boo! Anyway, it has been a loooong time since we posted a news message, bad us, and we will try to post more news messages again. Today we got some exclusive info nowhere else to be seen for you, and yes, its about the new Chunk thats currently being made and tested!

As I talked to Stephen the other day, I received a bunch of cool info which I, and sure you folks neither, knew.

Items are being added in this new Chunk, in fact, it'll be 200+ new items. And this patch, Rangers will receive much love (Quote from Zliten:"Because Rangers Suck, at the moment!"). That being said, I seen 2 new guns, of which one.. I actually already knew!
The first gun Zliten showed us was Algor's Freeze Popper, a wonderful looking gun. And it wasnt just a normal gun, no, it was a freakin' Ice Cream shooting gun! Yes, indeed, I said Ice Cream shooting, it actually shoots ice cream bolts, and they hurt.. alot.
The Second gun is one which some of you already knew, the Stiki Wiki Hot-Glue Gun! A gun so special.. so special I tell you, you nearly want to.. NOOO!! Dont touch it, Its hot and has Fire damage to weapon attacks on it! This gun drips off glue, and shoots bolts, which bounce back against objects! Next to that, its real fast (Wiki Wiki = fast in hawaii), in fact, its ludicrous speed. This gun links just like the Ten Ton Hammer to a website, called TheTownstons.com! Umm yeah.. you probably knew it already. Isnt that awesome? Thats DungeonRunners Team!! Pictures of these 2 guns can be found at the botom of this news Message.
Talking about rainbows, this Chunk will also include Rainbows that will Only drops from certain bosses! I even heard something like Rotgut having a Microphone rainbow (LOL). And some of these dropping-from-certain-bosses-only rainbows have special abilities, The Micrphone rainbow for example will have a chance of doing an automatic Butcher skill attack, by itself!
Also a wishing well will be placed in the game, your own personal gamble machine in-game! Ofcourse it does not require money to be put in, but instead a Kings Coin. You will be able to throw one in each hour, and it will return either crap, a purple or a rainbow! (Though I think it will be crap most of the time) Huray for a Wishing well!
Dungeons are being added in this Chunk too, and it will be a high-level one, too (I believe level 75+). This dungeon will include one real cool Boss fight (Epic, Stephen said).
But with good news also comes bad news, we level 100s have to say goodbye to Abbadon, he will now be for level 45-90. Bye Abby, I miss you already now pal, thanks for all the rainbows.
Guilds or better said, Posses, will be added in the next Chunk too. I think I am not saying anything new now, but its really worth a notice. I think this will be the biggest addition in this Chunk. You can make your own so called Posse and let all your friends join, and create one happy small (or big) community!
Character Blogs definitely are worth noticing too. I hear you ask already "what does that mean?!". Well, it means you will have your own Blog for your Character, and the coolest part is that its completely automatic! You will be able to look up you, your friend or Posse members through this neat system, and will be able to see when they gained a level, completed a quest, bought a potion (heh joke), killed a boss, got a rainbow, and much more! You do have the ability to put this feature off for your character, though.


And that was the big, big news post again. Enjoy! Pictures of the 2 guns can be found below. Enjoy and happy running!








28 May 2008

The Townstons Forums are finally up, enjoy your stay here. Any suggestions to make the forum better are welcome, and mind: Keep it civil, read the rules for more information. Click Here To go to the forums. Your account on the wiki is also used for the forums, also mind that you have to register to the Wiki itself Here to be able to see and use the Forums.

- --LegendRunner 08:52, 28 May 2008 (CEST)

16 May 2008

Heave 121 is OUT! There are some significant changes, especially in The Shadow's Embrace and Balzack's Burrow, as well as in the Social screens. We need everybody's help to get the updates posted to the wiki. For starters check out the updates to the NPC's and Quests pages.--Catwalksbyhimself 18:23, 16 May 2008 (CEST)

8 May 2008

Ouch.. 64 days without a single news message? I wonder how you people survived!

First, we are soon going to make a post at the forums as well as a page on the wiki about The Townstons Tournament! Yes yes I know, I promised it for a pretty long time now, but this time Im serious! Look at the soon-to-come post at the forums for more info!
Secondly, as you all have seen, the new DR Fansite Kit has been released at last! It contains bunches of pretty pictures and wonderful wallpapers. We will be updating some pages with the new images.
I'd also like to thank User:Catwalksbyhimself for a sick amount of contributions! He has fully updated the Builds section, made new framework for the Dungeon pages and added tons of information to the Monster section! Cat, thank you very much!
And, the unavoidable message, keep or start contributing, we are happy with every spell error corrected, and every item added!




5 March 2008

Yaa!! New News! (that did sound a bit strange).. We finally for a response from the big boss man about the Stiki Wiki Hot-Glue Gun (Made in Townston), the concept weapon of TheTownstons.com, and guess what? They gonna make it!
Yes, Indeed, what you (yes you at the other side of the screen) just said, 'Awesome!'
You can visit the page Here.
The artwork was made by Spetsdod, and the idea came off a couple of persons in-game.
For some more details..
Stephen mentioned that the gun might be one-handed, but there is a fair chance too it just becomes a 2-handed gun, because of the issues with one-hand gun wielding.
There will be a link to thetownstons.com in the stats, but the artwork will be re-done a bit, still based on the original artwork Spetsdod has made.
The Team simply loved the idea, both name and design, that they just wanted it into the game. It is unknown yet when the item will appear in-game.
--LegendRunner 21:50, 5 March 2008 (CET)
Stiki Wiki Hot-Glue Gun
(Made in Townston)


4 March 2008

New Armor Skins!!
I updated the Wiki icon pack and lookie! lookie! what I found!:
  • The rest of the Sunstone Armor and what I'll refer to as "Jade" Armor, see Fighter Armor page at the bottom.
  • No mention of this one in the patch notes, but there appears to be some new Mage Armor as well: Ninja gear, a Cavalry Hat and some Mouse Ears that weren't in there before.
  • There also appears to be some new shields in the icon pack as well: a Cinder shield, "Jade" shield and a "Sunstone" Shield
More Monsters
  • The Monsters page has gotten a recent revamp and muchos additions, the new monsters from build 110 will eventually make their way over there. Kudos go to Catwalksbyhimself (AKA Nunjabusiness) and Jesus Freak for their work.
Images Back Up
  • WOOT! Our illustrious leader, LegendRunner found Dorcas feeding a peanut butter sandwich into the one of the server drives. He grabbed the little troublemaker, ate his sandwich, sent the little bugger home crying to his mommy, and fixed everything up good and proper. Thumbnails and images are back up and running 100%. None too soon, because there are some good pics of Mobs floating around. Hat's off to da Boss of TT!
--Spetsdod 07:12, 5 March 2008 (CET)


28 February 2008

Hurray!! *does happy dance* The Interface guide is done, you can find it under Guides in the menu, hope you folks enjoy it.
--LegendRunner 16:15, 28 February 2008 (CET)
